policy.pricing_text: FRAs at the 21 May close (1x4 3.88, 3x6 4.02, 6x9 4.38, 9x12 4.65 vs WIBOR 3M 3.85) price roughly 80bp of NBP hikes within 12 months. The MPC held at 3.75% on 6 May (core probably rose in April; wait-and-see); Glapiński (7 May): the probability of a hike has risen and a cut is very unlikely - a CPI breach of 3.5% with persistent forecasts would trigger action. Tyrowicz (20 May): 3.75% is too low; Glapiński (18 May): no commitments. April CPI 3.2% (final, 15 May; flash 30 Apr, 3.0% expected); core 3.0% (18 May). The fuel VAT and excise cuts were extended to 31 May (13 May).
policy.risk_text: Global bond rout (UST 10Y ~4.6-4.7%, Bund ~3.2%, gilts ~5.2%) and hike pricing up to ~100bp, while the MPC says hold until July and April activity disappoints (GDP 3.4%, wages, retail) - the long end follows core markets.

macro.projection_text: NBP March projection (4 Mar; data to 19 Feb, war excluded): CPI 50% bands 1.6-2.9% (2026), 1.1-3.7% (2027); central path 2.3% / 2.4% / 2.3% (2026-28), GDP 3.9% in 2026; IMF (14 Apr): 2026 CPI 3.3%; EC (21 May): GDP 3.5% in 2026. The July projection is the next marker.
macro.fiscal_text: 2025 general-government deficit 7.3% of GDP (GUS EDP, 22 Apr), debt 59.7%; 2026 deficit cap PLN 271.7bn; budget deficit after April PLN 89.3bn (30.1% of the limit); the fiscal notification and the government's assumptions put the 2026 deficit at ~6.8% of GDP; EC (21 May): 6.5%, debt 64.5%; the SAFE loan was signed on 8 May; windfall-tax bill due in Q2 (75% of margins above the 2025 level +20%); fuel package (VAT 8%, minimum excise, price caps) extended to 31 May (13 May).
macro.fiscal_risk_text: 2026 needs ~51% (after 13 May, Millennium) financed; budget accounts ~PLN 184bn at end-April (MoF estimate); 8 May T-bill PLN 3.66bn at 4.151%; CHF 885m priced on 21 May (first CHF deal since 2015). S&P affirmed A-/stable (8 May); Scope moved its A outlook to negative (15 May); Fitch A- and Moody's A2 have negative outlooks.
macro.backdrop_text: The NBP held at 3.75% on 6 May; April CPI 3.2% y/y; Q1 GDP 3.4% y/y (flash). Ratings: Fitch A- negative, Moody's A2 negative, S&P A- stable (affirmed 8 May). 21 May: MoF sold PLN 10.0bn (offer 6-10bn, demand 13.3bn, cover 1.33) plus 0.04bn - PS0731 4.6bn at 5.43%, DS0436 1.8bn at 5.88%; MoF priced CHF 885m (3Y/7Y/10Y green), its first CHF deal since 2015; April data were soft: wages 5.4% (6.0% expected), industry 3.1% (4.1%), while construction (4.5%) and PPI (1.9% vs -0.1%) beat; EC: 2026 deficit 6.5% of GDP, debt 64.5%. Abroad: flash PMIs slumped (euro-area composite 47.5, services at a 5-year low); the EC cut 2026 euro-area GDP to 0.9%; a final draft Iran deal was reported late; Brent ~$104-108, Bund ~3.10%; Rehn: an ECB hike may be needed.

calendar.plan_text: MoF May plan (30 Apr): sale auctions on 13 May (PLN 6-12bn), 21 May (7-13bn) and 27 May (6-12bn) in OK0129 (new 2Y, replaces OK0128), NZ0331, PS0731, DS0436 and NZ0936; a 46-week T-bill on 8 May (3-6bn); no switch. ~49% of 2026 needs financed after the April sales. 8 May T-bill: PLN 3.66bn at 4.151% plus 0.55bn. 13 May sale: PLN 11.01bn vs 13.73bn demand (cover 1.25) plus 0.85bn; OK0129 4.868%, PS0731 5.360%, DS0436 5.854%, PS0130 5.018%. 21 May offer (19 May): PLN 6-10bn, cut from 7-13bn in the plan (DS1034 added). 21 May sale: PLN 10.00bn vs 13.28bn demand (cover 1.33) plus 0.04bn; OK0129 4.887%, PS0731 5.433%, DS0436 5.883%, DS1034 5.718%. CHF 885m priced (3Y/7Y/10Y green). BGK FPC (14 May): PLN 0.84bn on 1.10bn demand plus 0.15bn.
calendar.timing_text: The Aug 2025-Feb 2026 pattern (auction-day close the cheapest point of the week) comes from a rally regime; March's sell-off broke it and April's auction days cheapened on average. Remaining May sales: 27 May. Next MPC 1-2 Jun: a hold is expected; the July projection is the next marker. Covers: 1.25 (13 May), 1.33 (21 May) vs 1.13-1.25 in April.

core_text: Regime: talks in a 'final stage' - oil off its highs, core yields retreating; the NBP held at 3.75% on 6 May while FRAs price roughly 80bp of NBP hikes; the ECB is priced for a June hike, the BoE for hikes, the Fed has turned to hike risk, the CNB and MNB are on hold. Poland's 5Y CDS was 52bp and the 10Y spread to Bunds 283bp on benchmark bonds (Erste, 21 May close). Euro-area PMI 47.5; draft Iran deal (21 May).
